input.answer: I'd go with ב, the rows. The name and the shekel amount sit together on the right where I start reading, so on my phone I just go down the list: I put in 18,000, my employer added 54,000, tax took 13,974, I'm left with 66,513, and if I wait to year 6 it's 83,978. With א I'd have to match tall bars to labels at the bottom and to the numbers on top, and the 'if you wait' bar is out on the far left.

stuck.where: Small preview picture on the first screen
stuck.why: It has two parts, 'חשבון ניירות ערך' with 19,595 and 'קרן השתלמות' with 66,513. That's exactly the comparison I wanted, but it's tiny and I couldn't read it on a phone.

stuck.where: The big charts in both options
stuck.why: I came to compare the keren with a plain securities account, but the big charts only show the keren. The securities account only comes up in one sentence underneath (68,837 / 15,141 פחות), and I had to go back to the tiny picture to get the comparison.
It's 'minus' and has a pink striped top, and at first I wasn't sure which part was the tax. The ב row with '−13,974 ₪' written next to it is clearer.
The deposit changes from 18,000 to 21,600 and it took me a second to see the selected year had moved to 6.
